title: Microsoft Teams: granular channel notification controls
summary: The briefing matches the roadmap and Microsoft's notice, including the revised rollout windows, default state and recommended preparation. The Intune navigation and Graph call are documented, and the remaining feature-specific control and licensing gaps were confirmed by targeted searches.

claims.claim: Users get three per-channel presets named All new messages, Mentions and replies, and Mute.
claims.quote: Users will now be able to control their channel notification settings using three presets: All new messages, Mentions and replies, and Mute.

claims.where: controls[1].governs; Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance controls
claims.claim: Intune app protection is an existing general control over Teams notification content and suppression on iOS and Android.
claims.quote: Use the following options to configure your notifications on the portal through an app protection policy.

claims.claim: The documented Intune path is Apps > Protection > Create Policy > platform > Basics > Apps > Select public apps > Microsoft Teams > Data Protection > Org data notifications.
claims.quote:
On the Apps page, click Select public apps, then find and select the Microsoft Teams apps. Click Next.
6. On the Data Protection page, find the Org data notifications setting and select the Block org Data option.

claims.claim: The beta iOS/iPadOS policy API supports PATCH /beta/deviceAppManagement/iosManagedAppProtections/{iosManagedAppProtectionId} with body {"notificationRestriction":"blockOrganizationalData"}.
claims.quote:
PATCH /deviceAppManagement/iosManagedAppProtections/{iosManagedAppProtectionId}
notificationRestriction | managedAppNotificationRestriction | Specify app notification restriction

claims.where: controls[1].note; Risk assessment; Governance controls; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft has not confirmed how Intune Org data notifications interacts with the new channel presets and banner options.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams channel notifications presets Intune Org data notifications banner com.microsoft.teams.channel.notifications.IntuneMAMOnly. Read configure-teams-mobile and Android Org data notifications excerpt; general notification controls are documented, but no interaction with the new presets.

claims.claim: The Teams settings reference lists one setting under Notifications and feeds, concerning suggested feeds.
claims.quote:
#### Notifications and feeds
Navigation: Teams admin center > Teams > Teams settings
Suggested feeds can appear in a user's activity feed | On | When On, suggested feeds can appear in a user's activity feed.
